# Gold V1 — H2 data-quality gate

**Result: DATA QUALITY PASS**, 15 of 15 checks. The machine record is `data_quality.json`, regenerated by
`h2_study.py` on every run; the study aborts on any failure.

H2 reuses the corrected H1 pipeline unchanged: `research/gold_v1/h1/h1_study.py` is imported read-only with bytecode
writing disabled. The H1 folder is byte-identical to its state at the H1 close, with SHA-256 verified for all
12 files.

## Rerun H1 gate (checks 1–12)

These cover the same development rows as H1 (10,355 M15 bars, 2025-12-23 00:00 → 2026-06-02 23:45 UTC) and all
pass. The evidence is in `../h1/data_quality.md`:
- continuity: 113 gaps, all explained as daily break, weekend or US holiday;
- UTC and the New York-anchored broker day;
- London and New York DST;
- session boundaries;
- TVWAP reset;
- weighted mean and centred weighted variance;
- PDH/PDL from completed days;
- Asia range frozen and invisible to the pre-Asia evening bars;
- prefix invariance;
- spread semantics unresolved, used as indicative only;
- intrabar ambiguity flagged.

## H2 additions

| check | result | method |
|---|---|---|
| h2_prefix_invariance | PASS | H2 features (H1 direction, H1 expansion, ±1σ bands, candle ratios) and the full H2 event set recomputed on the first 70% of rows equal the full run on that prefix. Every event is identical in direction, signal bar, zone and stop. |
| h2_stop_causal | PASS | For every event the stop equals the extreme of the bars strictly after the pullback-start extreme, up to and including the signal bar. The entry is the next bar and extreme < touch ≤ signal. No pivot needs future bars. |
| h2_direction_completed_hour | PASS | The H1 direction and ER come from the last completed H1 bar only, and are constant within the signal's own hour. |

## Regression tests

`research/gold_v1/tests/test_pipeline.py`, 17 tests, all passing:

```
venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider research/gold_v1/tests
```

| requirement | tests |
|---|---|
| 1. Asia-range causality | `test_asia_range_invisible_before_it_exists`: a synthetic day's 03:00 Asia high is invisible to its 23:00–23:45 evening bars and to all Asia bars, and visible after 07:00. `test_asia_range_prefix_invariant`: cuts at 5, 40, 95 and 100 bars and the full length. |
| 2. σ precision | `test_tvwap_sigma_full_precision_near_4000`: at price ≈ 4000 with a tiny σ, TVWAP and σ match a centred `np.average` to < 1e-9. The test also shows that the uncentred E[x²] − m² formula would miss by > 1e-6, so it fails on the pre-fix code. |
| 3. UTC / DST | `test_sessions_follow_dst`: 9 boundary cases across the US (03-08) and UK (03-29) DST changes and the New York close. `test_timestamps_parse_as_utc_and_boundary_holds`: tz = UTC, the development cut holds, and the broker day ends at 17:00 New York in both EST and EDT. |
| 4. Previous-day values | `test_previous_day_uses_completed_days_only`: PDH/PDL equal the previous session's high/low and are NaN on the first day. |
| 5. TVWAP causal reset | `test_tvwap_resets_causally`: the first bar of each session has TVWAP = typical price and σ = 0, and a prefix run equals the full run. |
| H2 | `test_h1_direction_and_expansion_use_completed_hours`, `test_h2_events_prefix_invariant_and_stop_causal`. |

No frozen P3.1 or P2.x code was touched. No independent bug was found there.
